boundaries: The Fill/Stroke adapter projects selected colors to DOM but changes only enabled flags; remembered color state remains distinct.

Ghost selection mutates state/tool and can render before history. Repeated invocation does not clear existing proxies. Cleanup requests save, but guarded save returns can be followed by unflushed proxy removal.
Held-frame promotion is delegated before geometry iteration and may replace selectedPaths through loadFrame; helpers iterate the post-promotion global selection.
Geometry operations and required helper calls are incremental with no catch/rollback. Later failure preserves history, promoted frames, earlier path/adjunct changes and partial cleanup.
Line 3917 is outside coverage; the Timeline drag-state unit begins with heading at line 3918 and declaration at line 3919.

packets.responsibility: Reflects the last Fill/Stroke selection aspect into shared color DOM and enables the matching future-drawing channel without mutating selected geometry or remembered color values.
guards: Return unless state.tool is exactly fsselect and _fsSel is nonempty.
fsPrimarySel is tools.js `_fsSel.length?_fsSel[_fsSel.length-1]:null`; after the guard the result/path is dereferenced without a local null/path guard.

Fill branch requires kind fill or fillregion, truthy p.fillColor and exclusion of data.isVectorBrush/data.isFillShape. Stroke branch requires exact stroke and truthy p.strokeColor; it has no brush-shape exclusion.
projection: colorHex8 required. Fill-well/pm-fill or stroke-well/pm-stroke are required nodes.
setHex8Input helper is required, but each color-fill/pm-fill-c or color-stroke/pm-stroke-c node is optional because setHex8Input null-guards its el argument.
Fill toggle and Stroke toggle are both queried, but only Fill toggle is optionally used; Stroke synchronization delegates required window.SM._syncStrokeEnabledUI.
packets.state_effects: Fill writes state.fillEnabled=true; Stroke writes state.strokeEnabled=true. It does not assign state.fillColor and does not assign state.strokeColor, so remembered future-drawing colors can differ from reflected wells/inputs.
packets.non_effects: No selected path color, _fsSel, history, save/load, canvas render, export or native state mutation.
packets.returns_and_errors: Normal/guard completion returns undefined. Required color well/helper/SM failures retain preceding DOM/enabled writes; no rollback.
packets.caller: C19h-owned updateUI calls updateFsSelPanel at timeline line 2757.

packets.responsibility: Self-enables Ghost All, materializes editable proxy items for other keyframes, replaces selection, and later requests writeback/removes tagged proxies before reloading the active frame.
select_order: Capture activeLayerIdx/currentFrame and layer descriptor. Missing layer or symbolId calls required translated toast and returns.
When ghostAllFrames is false, set it true, require renderOS, optionally add active class. These state/render effects precede tool switch and history.
Require window.SM.setTool(select); capture userLayers[li] without a live-layer guard; then pushUndo. Tool transition retains C19a effects.
Iterate every frame except current. Only keyframes with nonempty strokes increment frameCount; this happens before per-stroke raster/revision exclusions.
For each non-raster/non-revision stroke, required desP into captured layer, required p.data.ghostFrame assignment, increment count.
Set _ghostProxyActive=count>0; replace selectedPaths and selectedStrokeIndices; require renderArcs/updateUI/toast.
selection_identity: Existing proxies are not removed first, so repeated selectGhostAll invocation can add duplicates.

A valid descriptor does not guarantee a live userLayers entry. With an undefined captured layer, no proxy can be created: the first eligible desP fails at layer.activate. With zero eligible strokes, count remains zero and _ghostProxyActive is assigned false before layer.children.filter fails.
selectedPaths becomes all captured layer children satisfying `instanceof Path && isSelectablePathChild`, including eligible current-frame Paths and old/new proxies. CompoundPath is excluded.
selectedStrokeIndices maps getSI and filters negative values. Proxy count, frameCount, Path selection count and index count can differ.
If a new run produces a zero proxy count while older proxies exist, _ghostProxyActive becomes false, potentially making clearGhostSelection guard them out.
cleanup_order: Falsy _ghostProxyActive returns. Otherwise call saveActiveLayerFrame first as a save request.

The callee increments scene version and may invalidate symbol bounds before guards. It can normally return before _writeBackGhostProxies for symbol, montage, Null, effect, guide, Widget, LFS, non-source-edit duplicator, live Rig pose, Path FX, invisible, or out-of-range layers. A matching freshly ensured stamp bypasses only the out-of-range guard; unsupported or invisible layers still return before the stamp is consumed. Cleanup then removes proxies unflushed.

A missing current layer can throw in saveActiveLayerFrame and prevent cleanup. If eligible, _writeBackGhostProxies groups active-layer children by ghostFrame and serializes them to tagged frames before current-frame collection.
Resolve userLayers[state.activeLayerIdx] after save request. Active-layer changes mean save/writeback/removal target the current layer, not the originally proxied layer.
Slice children and remove every child whose data.ghostFrame!==undefined. Mid-remove failure retains active flag and partial removal.
Set flag false; required clearSel replaces path/index/node selection and resets anchors/hover state; required loadFrame(currentFrame), then updateUI. No local undo.
callers: SM.toggleGhostAll at line 489 calls cleanup when disabling, then updateUI again.
btn-ghost-select click at line 11235 calls selectGhostAll.
packets.returns_and_errors: Undefined. No catch/rollback; all pre-failure state, proxy, selection, history and DOM effects remain. An undefined captured live layer preserves the earlier ghost flag, render, tool and history effects; frameCount can advance before the first eligible desP failure, while a zero-eligible pass assigns the active flag false before selection filtering throws.

packets.responsibility: Promotes eligible held Animation2D frames and translates current selected geometry with Move-specific linked/vector adjunct handling.
promotion: Skip when appMode motion or ensureKeyframe is absent. Resolve active layer/current frame; call ensureKeyframe only when frame exists and is neither keyframe nor interpolated.

Delegated ensureKeyframe may return when layer is not editable. On success it clones effective strokes, marks/stores current keyframe, stamps _justEnsuredKeyframeAt, loadFrame replaces live items/selection by stroke identity, and linked folders sync.
Move subsequently reads global selectedPaths after promotion, so it can operate on a replacement selection.
packets.guard_history: Return when both dx/dy are falsy or entry selectedPaths is empty. Unless skipUndo, pushUndo before promotion. skipUndo does not suppress promotion/mutation/save/render.
per_path: Create new Point(dx,dy) per path and translate path.
Optionally sync param shape box; required transformFillGradient maps each point via add(d).
Vector brush centerSegments points are replaced with new [x+dx,y+dy] arrays; no explicit outline rebuild.
Live linkedFill translates using a separate new Point. Every nonremoved brushCompanion translates.
packets.finalization: After current post-promotion selection loop, require fillRegenerateLinked(userLayers[current active index],null), saveActiveLayerFrame, renderArcs, updateUI in order. Empty replacement selection still reaches finalization.
packets.failure_semantics: Required failure preserves history, promotion, earlier paths, gradients and adjunct mutations.
callers: Non-vertex activeXformApplyMove wrapper at line 10682; live sp-x/sp-y fields at lines 10685-10686 route through it.

packets.responsibility: Scales or rotates post-promotion selected geometry, gradients and vector centerlines, then regenerates linked fills, saves and refreshes.
packets.shared_order: Identity/no-selection guard; optional pushUndo; _selPropsPromoteHeld; iterate current global selectedPaths; required linked regeneration/save/arcs/UI.
scale: Only exact sx===1 && sy===1 is identity. Path.scale around supplied anchor; optional param-box sync; gradient coordinates use independent factors.
Vector centerSegments use required scaleCenterSegments and rebuildVectorBrushOutline. linkedFill and brushCompanions are not directly scaled.
rotate: Any falsy deltaDeg, including 0 and NaN, is identity. Path.rotate then boxAngle assigned only when p.data exists.
boxAngle is ((old||0)+deltaDeg)%360. JavaScript negative remainder remains negative; no normalization to 0..359.
Gradient points rotate; vector centerSegments require rotateCenterSegments and outline rebuild. linkedFill/brushCompanions are not directly rotated.
callers: Live width/height fields at lines 10698-10717 and rotation field at line 10720 call wrappers. Vertex mode routes to node helpers.
packets.ownership: H03/#1060 retains tools.js rotate gesture and rotateCenterSegments mapping; referencing the helper does not transfer that scope.
packets.failure_semantics: No catch/rollback. Required helper failure retains history, promotion and prior geometry/adjunct effects.

source_consumers.disposition: FS reflection saves nothing. Ghost cleanup requests saveActiveLayerFrame, but normal unsupported/invisible/out-of-range guards can return before proxy writeback and cleanup then removes unflushed proxies. Eligible cleanup writes tagged frames. Geometry calls save after mutation, subject to its guards.
Ghost cleanup requires loadFrame after removal. Held promotion can call ensureKeyframe, which loads the promoted frame and replaces live selection. No parser/migration is implemented here.

Ghost selection pushes after state/tool setup; geometry pushes before promotion unless skipUndo. Cleanup has no local undo. Guarded/no-op and partial-failure history differences are explicit; C01 owns replay.
FS reads last _fsSel. Ghost replaces Path selection and stroke indices, excluding CompoundPath. Promotion may replace selectedPaths by stroke identity; geometry iterates that current selection.
Ghost proxies write back by ghostFrame to other frames when save guards permit. Held Animation2D frames may promote; interpolated/key/Motion frames do not. Motion transforms remain C02.
FS projects DOM only. Ghost calls onion/arcs/UI; geometry calls linked-fill regeneration/arcs/UI. Renderer implementations and any delegated effects remain owned elsewhere.
No export payload is generated. Only successfully saved frame/geometry changes reach later codecs/exporters; unflushed proxy removal can discard edits before export.
No direct SMEngineBridge, Tauri command, filesystem or native IPC call occurs in these functions. Delegated updateUI, loadFrame and setTool behavior remains with its existing Motion/native owners.
